publicationDecision.scope: Publish one bounded summary of three medicine-specific specialist-use semaglutide trial records. This is editorial authorisation, not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-source factual review; not clinical approval

entries.name: Semaglutide specialist-use trials
entries.stage: Three Phase 2/4 studies registered; all not yet recruiting
entries.summary: Three investigator-led registry records study semaglutide beyond its established weight-management use: weekly semaglutide versus placebo for chronic low-back-pain severity; pre-operative semaglutide and behavioural support before hip or knee arthroplasty; and semaglutide plus a levonorgestrel intrauterine device and structured weight loss for conservative treatment of endometrial atypical hyperplasia or grade 1 endometrial cancer.
entries.ukAuthorisation: Wegovy's UK weight-management authorisation is described separately. These registry records do not establish UK marketing authorisation for pain, peri-operative arthroplasty or conservative endometrial-treatment indications.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established for these investigational specialist uses.
entries.supply: UK supply for an authorised weight-management indication does not establish lawful supply or availability for these investigational specialist uses, pharmacy stock or sale by SHIFT.
entries.limitations: All three records remain not yet recruiting and have no posted results. Their estimated starts, including 1 October 2026 for the Canadian arthroplasty study, are plans rather than evidence that dosing began. Trial registration does not establish safety, efficacy, an authorised indication or a treatment recommendation.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07820358: Semaglutide, Weight Loss, and LNG-IUD
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted Phase 2 record read for not-yet-recruiting status, estimated dates, 48-participant design, pathological-response endpoint and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

discoveryDecision.included: The three records are combined into one research summary because they study the same established medicine in distinct specialist contexts and do not constitute three new commercial weight-management products.
discoveryDecision.plannedVersusCompleted: Every study remains not yet recruiting; estimated start dates are not treated as actual starts, and no results are posted.
discoveryDecision.ukPosition: The existing UK weight-management authorisation, NHS access and supply position is not transferred to the investigational specialist uses.
discoveryDecision.monitoring: No automatic source baseline, successful configured-source check or review renewal is created by this publication.
discoveryDecision.coverage: This addition does not imply that all investigator-led or specialist semaglutide research has been found.
